findings.message: LessonPage.tsx/CatchUpPage.tsx had used the legacy-number lookup (`lessonEntryByNumber`) against a value that is actually the URL's 1-based position, which task 4.3's resequence made diverge from legacy number starting at position 15 — any lesson at position ≥15 (lesson-unwritten-vowels, lesson-tone-marks, lesson-clusters, lesson-leading-consonants, lesson-numerals) would resolve content as 'undeclared' and show 'Lesson not found', even though `lesson.getScriptSummary` (routed through the already position-based `entryAt`) resolved the same lesson fine. Task 6.2's diff already fixes this (switches both pages to `lessonEntryByPosition`), but shipped with zero test coverage for it — LessonPage.tsx has no test file at all, and AC6's only proof (`LessonIntro.test.tsx`) exercises the `LessonIntro` component in isolation with a pre-resolved `content` prop, never through the page's own position→entry resolution. I reverted the fix locally, reproduced the exact 'Lesson not found' failure, restored it, and added `src/presentation/pages/LessonPage.test.tsx` asserting a position-15 lesson renders its deck; verified it goes red on the old lookup and green on the fix.

`LessonIntro.tsx` still gated `deckPhase` on `content.kind === "deck" && !deckDone`, a leftover from when `LessonContent` was a two-arm union; after task 6.2 collapsed it to a single-shape type, `content.kind` is always `"deck"` and the check is dead weight that reads as though a second arm might still exist. Simplified to `!deckDone` with a comment distinguishing it from the type-level exhaustive dispatch in `lessonContent.ts`, which the plan explicitly keeps for a different reason (protecting against a future third content source).

lessons.lesson: This phase's diff-stat lists symbols.ts and other files as changed against a very old base commit, so large hunks (lesson resequencing, priority values) actually belong to earlier phases (4.1/4.3) already reviewed — check `git log -- <file>` before attributing a hunk to the phase under review.
